tools.name: create_link
tools.description: Create a smart link. Only fallbackUrl is required; add targets for app stores, countryRules for per-country Android stores, a deeplinkUrl to open the installed app, a socialPreview for how the link looks when shared, and a slug for a readable URL. Returns the new link with its public url.

tools.name: delete_link
tools.description: Delete a link. It stops redirecting immediately, so confirm with the user first.

tools.name: get_account
tools.description: Plan of the account behind the API key, the features it includes (api, mcp, sdk), its link limit (null means unlimited) and how many links it has.

tools.name: get_account_stats
tools.description: Clicks across all of the account's links over a date range, with the same daily series and breakdowns as get_link_stats.

tools.name: get_link
tools.description: Read one link by slug: its public url, fallbackUrl, deeplinkUrl, per-platform targets, country rules and settings.

tools.name: get_link_stats
tools.description: Clicks for one link over a date range: total and unique clicks, clicks per day, and breakdowns by country, operating system, device, browser, referrer and outcome (app store, app opened, fallback page).

tools.name: get_link_timeseries
tools.description: Clicks per day for one link over a date range, without the breakdowns. Use it for trends and charts.

tools.name: get_top_links
tools.description: The account's links ranked by clicks over a date range, best first. Use it to answer which links or campaigns performed best.

tools.name: list_domains
tools.description: The account's custom domains (for example go.acme.com) with their status (pending, verifying, active, error), the DNS record to add, which domain is the default for link URLs, and how many domains the plan allows (limits.used and limits.max). Business and Enterprise plans.

tools.name: list_links
tools.description: List the account's links, newest first, with their destinations and targets. Use search to find a link by slug or title.

tools.name: update_link
tools.description: Change an existing link. Only the fields you send change; the slug itself cannot be changed. Returns the updated link.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp.appy.to" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: create_link, get_link, list_domains · Private data: get_account, list_domains · Public sink: update_link · Destructive: delete_link.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: create_link, get_link, list_domains · Private data: get_account, list_domains · Public sink: update_link · Destructive: delete_link

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
